metadata.description: Curated, license-audited MIT skill bundles per domain profile, from claude-bootstrap. Install a domain bundle directly with /plugin, or use the claude-bootstrap CLI to scaffold a full project (CLAUDE.md + settings + bundles).

plugins.name: universal-software
plugins.description: Default general-purpose bundle: prevention before new code, hotspot-driven refactoring, post-crash state recovery, a reuse/minimalism review lens, and a security gate for adopting third-party agent skills (5 skills, first-party MIT).

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend skills: React/Tailwind artifacts, webapp testing, browser automation, UI design systems (7 skills, MIT).

plugins.name: data-science
plugins.description: Data-science skills: ML/data engineering, RAG, SQL, computer vision (6 skills, MIT).

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: DevOps skills: CI/CD, Kubernetes, runbooks, observability, secrets (5 skills, MIT).

plugins.name: academic
plugins.description: Academic/scientific skills: citation management, exploratory data analysis, exa-search (3 skills, MIT).

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend / web-service skills: config-only (never installs deps), permission baseline + curated skills for FastAPI/Flask/Django/Express/Rails/Spring (4 skills, MIT).
